notes.title: Hottest Mom award?
notes.content:
As many of you will have seen, Steam are introducing the Steam Awards!

Seeing as so many comments picked up on how hot Aya's Mom is, how about a 'Hottest Mom' award?

With your support, I think we can win!

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/179728612893655041/251125115658567680/votemom.png[/img]

You can vote on the Sweet Volley High store page!

notes.title: Nutaku early release!
notes.content:
Just for your information, a full content release goes live on Nutaku.net on October 7. That's less than 24 hours away!

The Steam release will go live October 26, 2016.

I'm excited to hear your feedback on the game!
